placements.title: Operational Safety Practices Around Deployment and Rollback
placements.theme: Deployment safety is sustained through recurring rehearsal and named accountability rather than one-off procedure.

placements.title: Rehearsed Rollback Is the Only Rollback That Counts
placements.theme: A rollback capability is only real once it is regularly rehearsed, which is why Atlas rollback drills now run on a fixed monthly cadence.
placements.why: src-1 and src-3 both state the same enduring cadence fact (monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals) in direct and formalized decision-record form, and src-2 supplies the standing rationale ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have') that will keep justifying future rehearsal cycles beyond this single envelope — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf exists in this empty graph, so this is a mint under the newly minted DeploymentSafety strata.

placements.title: Accountability Anchors Deployment Safety Decisions
placements.theme: Operational safety decisions endure only when a named individual is accountable for carrying them out.
placements.why: src-4 assigns Quinton Fairweather as Owner of the rehearsal cadence decision, with footing that keeps him as animator/author/principal rather than the session. This names an ongoing accountability theme (named ownership of operational decisions) distinct from the cadence theme itself, so it is placed as its own leaf under DeploymentSafety rather than folded into the rehearsal-cadence leaf or left as a bare fact.
